incidents-bot: [PAGER] P1: EU inference cache thrashing detected - elevated 503 rate for /v1/generate. Pager triggered for oncall @eva-oncall. Incident link: https://redwood.incidents/1745556789

 eva-oncall: acked, joining war room: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/xyz123

 alice.sre: I'm on standby, will pull runtime logs and check recent rollouts. Suggest owners: eva = incident owner, alice = runtime SRE, frank = infra.

 bob-platform: can we temporarily bump capacity or route EU traffic to warm nodes?

 frank-infra: checking autoscaler and node metrics now; possible KV cache eviction storm. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime -c autoscaler --tail=200
```

 carla-support: support heads-up: prepping customer list and template messages. Need status page copy.

 dan-product: quick impact summary: ~5% of EU requests return 503s, functionality intermittent. Dedicated reserved pools unaffected. Recommend "partial degradation" language.

 eva-oncall: assigning owners: Incident owner: eva-oncall; SRE lead: alice.sre; Infra: frank-infra; Support: carla-support; Product: dan-product. Please react with ack.

 alice.sre: ack

 frank-infra: ack

 carla-support: ack

 dan-product: ack

 eva-oncall: war room link pinned above. Mitigation plan: 1) frank applies temporary autoscale burst 2) alice to validate no bad runtime rollout; rollback if needed after 10m 3) carla/dan coordinate statuspage + customer notify.

 carla-support: statuspage draft:
"We are investigating elevated errors for inference requests in the EU region. Some requests may receive 503 responses. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue. No action required from customers at this time. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."

 dan-product: looks good. Add: "Reserved/dedicated pools in EU are not impacted."

 eva-oncall: carla, please post that + notify affected customers tagged EU-inference. Use priority notify.

 carla-support: Posted to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1745556789. Notified 12 customers on EU-inference list.

 incidents-bot: Statuspage update posted by carla-support. Notified 12 subscribers.

 alice.sre: quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T14:02:34Z runtime INFO kvcache evict count=842 node=eu-1
```

 frank-infra: applied autoscale burst +4 nodes to eu pool. Watching error rate and latency.

 eva-oncall: monitoring — error rate down ~40% since scale. Keeping war room open. Reconvene in 15m or earlier if regressions.

 carla-support: sending templated customer DM:
"We observed intermittent 503 errors affecting EU inference. Engineers applied temporary capacity and are investigating root cause. We will follow up when the service is stable. Contact support for urgent issues"

 alice.sre: if error rate keeps dropping we'll plan a controlled rollback of change X in 20m to validate root cause correlation.

 eva-oncall: thanks all. I'll keep this thread as the source-of-truth for comms and timeline notes. Please post all external comms text here before publish.

 carla-support: ack — next update scheduled at :15 and :30.

 incidents-bot: Pager cleared by eva-oncall (ack cleared). Incident remains active for investigation and postmortem tracking.
